question_1_is_the_COUNT_enriched.verdict: NO. Three convergent compounds among 482 is what the library's own flag rate would predict (2.2 expected). The docking selection did not preferentially capture compounds the ligand-based model flags. This must be stated plainly; the convergence claim cannot rest on the count.

question_2_is_the_IDENTITY_random.verdict: NO. Drawing three at random from the 23 flagged compounds gives all Flavones with p=0.020 and all Pongamia pinnata with p=0.002. The structure-based arm, selecting on docking score alone, recovered a chemically coherent set.

post_hoc_warning: The Flavone/Pongamia coherence was NOTICED and then tested. It is an exploratory observation, not a pre-registered hypothesis, and must be labelled as such in the manuscript.
manuscript_framing: Report both. The number of convergent compounds is unremarkable; their chemical coherence is not. Claiming enrichment on the count alone would not survive review.
